findings.description: Retrieved all seven directory result pages (page=0..6) with curl, listed as dir-p0..dir-p6 sources. Stdlib parsing enumerated 69 person cards (10 per page, 9 on page 6). Names and profile slugs match brief.people exactly: no omission in either direction.

No courtesy, joint/secondary, incoming, visiting or start-date text appears on any directory card. The only explicit ECE affiliated designation is Christof Paar. No incoming appointments are announced in the sources, so no effective dates are recorded.

Scope limit: only the ECE-filtered directory list was checked (brief.lists). ECE professors absent from this filter cannot be ruled out from these sources, and no unfiltered directory or other list was fetched.
All five optional profile pages fetched successfully and are cited (profile-paar, profile-moritz, profile-philips, profile-saxena, profile-sang). No source_failure.

Emeritus ECE professors (Anderson, Hollot, Koren, Pozar, Schaubert, Yngvesson) are excluded as emeritus with current_state past. Their membership is recorded as ece because they are listed under the ECE department.

Non-professorial ECE staff are excluded as academic_professional (accounting, program, advising, business manager, administrative roles), and the lab technician as research_staff. Lecturers and senior lecturers are excluded as teaching.

Included as affiliate_professor. The card and the official profile both designate him Affiliated Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering, which is an explicit ECE-designated affiliated appointment. Membership ece, current.

Excluded as research_only, not_in_core. Card and profile list Professor Emeritus plus an active Research Professor ECE appointment. The category is a judgment call (emeritus vs research_only); excluded under either reading.
Excluded as research_only, not_in_core. Paros Research Professor (ECE) is a research-only professorial appointment; the Center co-directorship is not an ECE professorial appointment.

Excluded as teaching. The card and profile show Lecturer only, with no rank that would qualify. The card has no unit line; the profile lists ECE as related department. The decision does not depend on unit.

Excluded as adjunct; membership cs_only. The professorial title is Computer Science. The only ECE role is Adjunct, which the policy excludes and which is not an official EE/ECE professorial affiliation.
Excluded as adjunct; membership cs_only. Professorial title is CICS (Assistant Professor). ECE role is Adjunct assistant professor only.
Excluded as adjunct; membership cs_only. Assistant Professor, Computer Science. ECE role is Adjunct only.
Excluded as adjunct; membership cs_only. Distinguished Professor, CICS. ECE role is Adjunct only.
Excluded as adjunct; membership ece. The only ECE role is Adjunct Associate Professor, which is excluded. No regular or courtesy ECE appointment is stated.
Excluded as adjunct; membership ece. The only ECE role is Adjunct (no rank stated).
Included as regular. Distinguished Professor, ECE is the primary appointment; the Adjunct role in the Manning college does not change the ECE professorial appointment.

Official profile URL uses the non-name slug /engineering/about/directory/assistant-professor. The page is titled and headed Yuanrui Sang, Assistant Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering, which matches the card. Included as regular.

Several ECE professors also hold adjunct or secondary roles in other units (e.g., Irwin, Noh, Zink, Polizzi, Siqueira, Nehra, Niffenegger, Xu, Yao). Each keeps the regular ECE professorial appointment; no courtesy or joint designation is stated for any of them.

Scope note: membership ece is used for every person listed under the ECE department. Excluded ECE staff, emeriti and lecturers are recorded as ece with the excluded category driving the decision. Membership cs_only is used only where the professorial title is in CS/CICS and the ECE role is adjunct.
